description: This Java class, 'GlobalEventRegistry', manages registration and deserialization strategies for 'Event' subclasses within the Ditto framework. It implements singleton pattern, allows customization of parse strategies, and resolves event types from JSON objects.

classes.name: GlobalEventRegistry
classes.description: A singleton registry class that manages strategies for deserializing Event subclasses from JSON objects and headers, extending a generic global JSON parsable registry.

classes.name: EventParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: A nested factory class that provides strategies to extract parse keys and method names from annotated Event classes for deserialization.

methods.name: customize
methods.description: Returns a new registry instance with custom parse strategies, replacing or adding entries.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the event type string from a JsonObject, using 'type' field or fallback to 'id'.
